summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned solely by maintain-knowledge-base via append-only, maintainer-confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, one existing target plan, pinned main commit, timestamp, non-automatic status, authority, and hash-verified stale maintenance route; publish command fails closed without bindings; stale-catalog route is typed, hash-bound, non-authorizing, and persisted in target plan; VDD/Acceptance restrict outputs to exact target directory; semantic catalog excludes authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive dependency; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates layers/pointers with validated capability; versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/registry files select highest numeric version, supporting both requirements-ledger and requirements names; historical generations remain readable, new publications record summary/hash; extends ADR-0044, ADR-0048, ADR-0050; no ADR superseded
